component.name: KelvinCal
component.summary: Calibrate displays in hardware and with ICC profiles
Monitore in der Hardware und mit ICC-Profilen kalibrieren

description.p: KelvinCal calibrates displays under KDE Plasma on Wayland. It first sets the white point and brightness in the display's own hardware over DDC/CI, then measures an ICC profile with ArgyllCMS and activates it in KWin.

ul.li: Contrast search, white point and luminance control loop, patch measurement and profile in one run
Targets for photo, office, sRGB, soft proof, video and evening, or several of them in one batch
Inspector with tone curves, gamut coverage, kink check and live comparison with the previous profile
ΔE2000 verification with an HTML report
Presets switch brightness, contrast, RGB gains and ICC profile of all displays at once, also from the panel widget and the command line
Colorimeter corrections (.ccss/.ccmx), including your own measured with a spectrometer

description.p: A measuring instrument supported by ArgyllCMS is needed for calibrating; adjusting the hardware needs displays with DDC/CI.

screenshot.caption: Choose a display and a purpose, then start the calibration
Calibration running: contrast search, white point control loop, patch measurement
Inspector: tone curves, gamma, gamut coverage and kink check
Verification with ΔE2000 test patches and gray balance
